title: Is breakfast the most important meal of the day?

vocabulary.meaning: the first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning
examples: She eats breakfast before going to work.

vocabulary.meaning: the chemical processes through which the body uses energy
examples: People often discuss whether breakfast affects metabolism.
Metabolism is influenced by many factors.
A high-protein breakfast may affect appetite later in the day.

vocabulary.meaning: the process of obtaining and using food needed for health
examples: Breakfast quality matters more than simply eating anything.
Good nutrition depends on the whole diet.

vocabulary.meaning: to not do or have something that would normally be expected
examples: He often skips breakfast when he is busy.
Skipping a meal affects people differently.

vocabulary.meaning: a meal containing a useful combination of food groups and nutrients
examples: Eggs, vegetables, and whole-grain bread can make a balanced meal.
Try to start the day with a balanced meal.
